name: Mazhar H
short: Senior software engineer with 8+ years of experience building software products.
bio: Mazhar founded Corevex Solutions in 2022 and leads the company's direction, delivery standards and client relationships. A senior software engineer with more than eight years of experience, he brings a hands-on engineering view to every project and makes sure each build is planned for quality, scale and long-term ownership.

name: M Azhar
short: Solution architect and web application developer who designs how every system fits together.
bio: Azhar co-founded Corevex and leads solution architecture. He turns client goals into technical plans, choosing the right stack, structure and integrations before development begins. As a web application developer, he stays close to the code and guides engineering teams through complex builds.

name: Zafar H
short: Head of business and customer success, with 8 years in sales.
bio: Zafar runs Corevex's operations and leads business development and customer success. With eight years in sales, he makes sure clients get a clear process, honest communication and a partner who stays involved long after launch.
